rationale.bev_range: Derived from sampled single-frame LiDAR XY span, rounded up to stable multiples of 5 m.
rationale.patch_size: Anchored to the same local coverage so patch size and BEV crop stay comparable.
rationale.bev_resolution: Coarser candidates are preferred when the global map spans a larger area.
rationale.accumulation_num_frames: Chosen to cover roughly 0.5 m, 1.0 m, and 2.0 m of median inter-frame motion.
